Bit balling and mud rings have been reported with varying degrees in virtually all wells

drilling with seawater and controlling the drilling rate at meters per minute (1.5 ft per minute) or 27 meters per hour (89 ft per hour). Attempts to control the gumbo in this area with weighted mud have been/successful. ON Sloughing shales have been reported in the lower part of the Eo- cene. These shales can usually be controlled with good quality high yield strength mud. 2.3.4 Lost Circulati
